https://staffline.compunnel.com/Support/: Job Summary We are seeking an IT Software Asset Management Developer to support Software Asset Management (SAM), ServiceNow development, and the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) project. The role will primarily focus on ITSAM activities (80%) and SBOM-related work (20%). Responsibilities include ingesting SBOM data from GitLab and software vendors, mapping data to appropriate systems, developing APIs and integrations, and supporting software asset management and governance processes. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management, particularly SAM Pro, along with data integration and software asset management capabilities. Key Responsibilities •    Support the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) project and manage its associated development backlog. •    Ingest SBOM data from GitLab and software vendors into the enterprise environment. •    Map and organize SBOM data within appropriate systems and locations. •    Establish connections between SBOM data and the corresponding software assets across the enterprise environment. •    Support Software Asset Management (SAM) activities and develop related platform functionality. •    Build and maintain API calls and integrations to support data exchange across systems. •    Manage significant data movement, transformation, and mapping activities. •    Evaluate and support the integration of Technopedia data. •    Support software governance processes to ensure software follows the appropriate systems and approval procedures before being introduced into the environment. •    Provide ServiceNow and SAM support for additional team initiatives as required. Required Qualifications •    Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management, particularly SAM Pro. •    Strong understanding of Software Asset Management processes beyond basic ServiceNow platform development. •    Experience with APIs, integrations, and enterprise data movement and mapping. •    Experience working with SBOM data from sources such as GitLab and software vendors. •    Ability to ingest, map, and associate software data with corresponding assets across enterprise environments. •    Understanding of software governance processes and controls for introducing software into enterprise environments. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience integrating or working with Technopedia. •    Experience with GitLab. •    Previous experience supporting SBOM implementations or projects. •    Experience in financial services or banking environments. •    Strong experience with software governance processes.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
As a Backend Engineer on the Profile & Community team within Airbnb’s Passport & Commerce organization, you’ll help build the social layer of Airbnb: a trusted social graph of real-world connections, the social features built on top of it, and the foundations that let people connect with the travelers they know and the people they meet along the way. The team is highly collaborative with its partners in design, product, data science, legal, and marketing to deliver features and experiences used by millions of people. We work closely with other engineering teams to ensure we build systems that are performant and configurable with architecture that's scalable and robust.
A Typical Day:
Collaborate with the other engineering teams across the stack while working closely with counterparts within Knowledge Graph, Search, Listings, Trips, and others to build scalable and high quality platforms and foundations.
Work closely with cross functional partners to define and execute on products and features that enable our guests and hosts to set up their accounts and profiles quickly and easily.
Build efficient and reusable backend components, architect reliable, performance and scalable systems.
Evaluate and prototype new technologies and techniques that can enable faster iterations and execution across our tech stack.
Mentor and support other engineers in the team or in related teams.
Your Expertise:
3+ years industry experience
Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience
Experience in building and scaling high-quality and high-traffic products (or systems).
Ability to evaluate technical approaches and design product solutions to solve real-world problems.
Ability to drive alignment, manage projects and effectively collaborate with stakeholders.
